text: APPROVE. The extractions keep the original stage order, conditions (`only is not null && only != Bench` is equivalent to `!all && only != Bench`), `Broken` flags, messages, cache and log behaviour, and the extracted pieces bring `CheckAsync` well under 15. The one gap is that the diff doesn't show the tail of the old method that moved into `JudgeSideMovesAsync`, so I couldn't confirm it doesn't use `arm`, `head` or `baseArm`; if it does, the build would fail.
